# wfptt -- 对讲 SDK：频道、抢麦、AMR-NB 分片
#
# Generated by tools/pack_sdk.py. Do not edit: the next packaging run
# overwrites it, and the lists below are read out of the build that produced
# the archive rather than maintained by hand.
#
# This is the same component the source tree registers, with the source taken
# out: no SRCS, so idf_component_register creates an INTERFACE library, and
# lib/libwfptt.a is attached to it. It carries the objects of wfptt
# (esp32s3). Kconfig is not part of the package -- every option is already
# compiled in; see ../README.md for the values.

idf_component_register(
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES wfc
)

# add_prebuilt_library rather than a bare path, for the link order: it makes
# the archive a CMake target that depends on the components below it, so the
# linker sees libwfptt.a before the libraries that resolve its references.
# IDF does not put component libraries in a --start-group by default.
add_prebuilt_library(wfptt_prebuilt "lib/libwfptt.a"
    REQUIRES wfc
    PRIV_REQUIRES esp_timer
)

target_link_libraries(${COMPONENT_LIB} INTERFACE wfptt_prebuilt)
